environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with API Gateway (Cognito User Pool authorizer). The Lambda execution role has a broad DynamoDB policy: dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:DeleteItem on arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:123456789012:table/UsersTable. No IAM condition keys are applied. The Cognito authorizer validates the JWT token but the Lambda role itself has unrestricted access to all items in the table.
